steps.say: Every school's row carries its two joining links in the Links column. This is how you chase a school that has not got started, or replace a link somebody has lost.
**Admin** copies its admin link and **Teacher** copies its teacher link. The chip reads Copied so you know it worked, then you paste it into an email or a message.
Tapping a chip never opens the school — the rest of the row does that. A school still flagged as awaiting admin is one whose admin link nobody has opened yet.
steps.terminal: That's both links, always on the row, always fetchable again. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
